sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for display pieces
sections.what: Brings in icons, the markdown renderer, a markdown extension for tables and checklists, and the response type.
sections.why: Likely reason: each import supplies one part of the card.

sections.name: AnswerDisplayProps
sections.title: Input type for answer card
sections.what: Declares that the card receives one query result.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes the required input explicit, so mistakes are caught while building.

sections.name: AnswerDisplay (part 1)
sections.title: Badge colours and source labels
sections.what: Chooses badge colours from the confidence level and builds a label for each source's page, slide or sheet. Draws the card title, the confidence badge, the query understanding line when present, and the answer text.
sections.why: Likely reason: the coloured badge gives a quick signal of confidence before the owner reads the answer.
sections.watch_out: Only high, medium and low have their own colours, and any other value is shown as medium.

sections.name: AnswerDisplay (part 2)
sections.title: Source list with links
sections.what: Draws the numbered source list with file name, location, relevance percentage and a SharePoint link when one exists.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the owner open the original document quickly.
sections.watch_out: A relevance score of exactly zero is hidden, so a weak match looks the same as a source with no score.

sections.name: AnswerDisplay (part 3)
sections.title: Metadata summary grid
sections.what: Shows counts of evidence items and context items used, plus the folder filter when one was set.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows how much material the answer was based on.
sections.watch_out: Each count is read straight from the reply, so a missing count shows as blank.

summary: Shows one answer card: a confidence badge, the answer in formatted text, a numbered list of sources with links, and counts of the evidence used.
purpose: Lets the owner read the answer and judge how strong it is and where it came from.
why: Likely reason: a separate component keeps answer display apart from the question form.
how: Receives the query result. Picks badge colours from the confidence level. Builds a location label for each source. Draws the title and badge, the query understanding line when present, the markdown answer, the source list with optional links, and a small metadata grid.
inputs: A query result with the answer, confidence, sources, metadata and an optional analysis part.
outputs: A white card with the answer text, source list and counts.
risks: Reads result.metadata and result.confidence directly, so a reply missing those fields can crash the page. Unknown confidence values fall back to the medium colours. Sources with a relevance score of zero are hidden.
debug: If the card is blank or the page crashes, open the browser developer console and compare the reply with the QueryResponse type. If a source link is missing, check the sharepoint_url value in the reply.
